summary: Full-stack test of IT-Tabelander. Backend: created pytest suite (51 tests) covering health/SEO, auth (cookies+bearer+lockout), services, FAQs, reviews, repairs, contact, configurator (ps5+pc, save/fetch, admin CRUD), Dolibarr demo layer, media upload/serve/traversal, settings, dashboard, and auth-guard checks -> 50/51 pass. Frontend: Playwright E2E of home, theme toggle+persistence, consent banner, all nav (header/Mehr/mobile/footer), 8 public routes, 6-step repair wizard (submitted, got REP-YRGM0R), contact form, PS5 configurator (live SVG recolor + price summary + save), PC configurator (AM5+Z790 conflict detected, PSU wattage warning, save), and full admin CMS (login, all 10 sections, service create/save, review create, Dolibarr demo sync, settings save+persist, logout). Found 1 critical backend security bug, 1 critical admin-crash bug (fixed by me), and 1 critical site-wide form-input contrast bug.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout is broken in two ways. (1) TypeError -> HTTP 500: app/routers/auth.py:25 compares `locked_until` (naive datetime read back from Mongo) with `now_utc()` (tz-aware) -> 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Once an identifier reaches 5 failures the endpoint returns 500 FOREVER for that IP+email, even with the CORRECT password (permanent self-DoS of the admin account). Reproduced against localhost: 401,401,401,401,401,500,500. Fix: store/compare tz-aware (e.g. `locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` or compare with `datetime.utcnow()` consistently) and return 429. (2) Lockout never triggers via the public URL at all: identifier = `request.client.host` which behind the k8s ingress is the rotating proxy pod IP (observed 10.169.3.135 and .136 splitting a 6-attempt burst into 3+3). Use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) and/or an email-only counter.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' forces allow_credentials=False, so the httpOnly auth cookies can never be used by the browser cross-origin; auth silently depends on the localStorage bearer fallback only. Playbook expects explicit origins + allow_credentials=True. localStorage token storage is also XSS-exposed.

No 404 on unknown id - update_one silently matches nothing and (services/faqs/reviews) then return null/200 instead of 404. Also invalid ObjectId strings raise bson.InvalidId -> 500 instead of 400 (no is_valid_oid guard, although app/db.py provides one).
Duplicate slugs are allowed (services.slug index is non-unique); GET /api/services/{slug} then only ever returns the first document.

Fully unauthenticated and unthrottled with no honeypot/consent check - open to spam flooding of saved_configurations. Same for POST /api/uploads/repair-attachment (public image upload, no rate limit).

ui_bugs.component: components/ui/input.jsx (Input/Textarea/Select - used by EVERY form on the site)
ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: text the user types is invisible. Computed style is background-color rgb(255,255,255) with color rgb(248,250,252). Root cause: tailwind.config.js maps colors to bare CSS vars (`elevated: 'var(--bg-elevated)'`) without the `<alpha-value>` placeholder, so the opacity modifier `bg-elevated/60` in the Input base class emits an invalid color and the input falls back to the browser default white background. Verified on /kontakt (contact-name/email/subject/message), /reparatur step 6 (repair-name/email/phone/contact-method) and /admin (admin-email/admin-password). Fix: define colors as `rgb(var(--bg-elevated) / <alpha-value>)` with space-separated RGB vars, or drop the /opacity modifiers. Note `bg-surface/40` (6 usages) and `bg-elevated/50|70` are broken by the same cause.

FIXED BY ME: `useEffect(load, [])` passed an async loader that returns a Promise as the effect, so React used the Promise as the cleanup function -> 'destroy is not a function' crashed the whole admin SPA to a blank page as soon as you navigated to Nachrichten or changed the Reparaturen filter. 7 of 10 admin sections were unreachable. Changed to `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [...])` in AdminContact/Services/Faqs/Reviews/Media/Dolibarr/Repairs/Configurator. Re-verified: all 10 sections load, 0 page errors.

A component is defined inside AdminLayout's render (eslint react/no-unstable-nested-components). React re-creates the type each render and destroys the subtree DOM/state - this is what made the effect-cleanup bug above fire so aggressively. Should be hoisted out.

Testability gap: edit/delete/visibility icon buttons in AdminServices, AdminReviews, AdminFaqs, AdminContact have no data-testid (only service-edit-{slug} exists). Contact message rows have no data-testid at all. Add e.g. service-delete-{slug}, review-delete-{id}, contact-row-{id}.

integration_issues.issue: Every public page fires GET /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors and logs two 'Failed to load resource: 401' console errors. Should skip the call when no token is present.

issues: Every component option (CPU, RAM, PSU, case, OS...) uses the same irrelevant stock photo (upgrades-systempflege-1200.webp of hands holding hardware) as its thumbnail - misleading; either use per-part images or drop the thumbnail.

design_issues.screen: Reparatur wizard step 6 / Kontakt / Admin login
issues: Inputs render as white boxes in the dark theme, breaking the whole dark-tech look, in addition to the invisible-text bug above.
Sonner toast renders on top of the header CTA 'Reparatur anfragen' (top-right) and covers it while visible.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix login lockout - make locked_until comparison tz-aware (currently 500s forever after 5 fails, locking out admin permanently) and key the counter on X-Forwarded-For / email instead of request.client.host (rotating ingress IP makes lockout unreachable).
CRITICAL: Fix Tailwind color/alpha config so bg-elevated/60 works - all form inputs currently have white bg + white text (typed text invisible on /kontakt, /reparatur, /admin).
Hoist the nested component out of AdminLayout.jsx:32 (react/no-unstable-nested-components).
Return 404 (not null/200) and 400 on invalid ObjectId for admin PUT/DELETE endpoints; use app/db.py is_valid_oid.
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins and allow_credentials=True so httpOnly cookie auth actually works instead of relying on a localStorage bearer token.
Add spam protection (honeypot/rate limit) to POST /api/configurator/save and POST /api/uploads/repair-attachment.
Add data-testid to admin edit/delete icon buttons and contact rows.
Enforce unique slug on services collection.
Fix remaining eslint errors (unescaped quotes, 2 empty catch blocks).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:_check_lockout compares a Mongo-returned naive datetime against a tz-aware now_utc() -> guaranteed TypeError/500 for any locked identifier; this converts the rate limiter into a permanent account lockout.
Rate limiting keyed on request.client.host is meaningless behind an ingress/load balancer; the proxy pod IP was observed rotating between requests in this very environment.
Tailwind custom colors declared as bare `var(--x)` cannot be used with /opacity modifiers - this silently produced invalid CSS in the shared Input component and broke every form on the site.
useEffect(load, deps) where load returns a Promise is a hard React runtime error, not just a warning; it was repeated in 8 admin files (copy-paste/DRY smell).
Admin write endpoints do no existence checks and do not validate ObjectId format, so bad ids surface as 500s.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows pass after my admin fix; blocking input-contrast bug remains)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed data (service, FAQ, review, repair REP-YRGM0R, contact message, media, settings phone/email) was created and then deleted/restored. Verified GET /api/reviews back to {count:0}, dashboard total_repairs=0, settings email/phone restored to "". Leftover harmless artifacts: 4 rows in saved_configurations and 2 rows in media (repair attachments) - no delete API exposed for saved configs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (+conftest.py) and runs in ~8s against the public URL: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q`. Only TestAuth::test_bruteforce_lockout fails (expects 429 on the 6th failed login). IMPORTANT: after running lockout tests, wipe the login_attempts collection (`db.login_attempts.delete_many({})`) or the admin account can become permanently un-loginable because of the 500 bug. Frontend flows already verified end-to-end: repair wizard, contact, both configurators, all admin sections. Not yet tested: admin media upload via UI (backend API covered), admin FAQ/Konfigurator create-forms, password reset flow (no email transport), forgot/reset token happy path, tablet breakpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Lockout: BSON stores datetimes without tzinfo, so `locked_until` read back from Mongo is naive while now_utc() is aware -> TypeError inside _check_lockout, surfaced as 500 for every subsequent login attempt from that IP+email (including correct credentials). Separately the identifier uses request.client.host, which in this k8s cluster is the ingress pod IP and rotates, so the 5-attempt threshold is never reached from an external client. 2) Invisible form text: tailwind.config.js maps `elevated: 'var(--bg-elevated)'`; Tailwind's `/60` opacity modifier needs an `<alpha-value>` placeholder, so `bg-elevated/60` compiles to an invalid background-color declaration, the input falls back to the UA default white background while `text-ink` stays #F8FAFC. 3) Admin blank page: `useEffect(load, [])` returned a Promise; React invoked it as the cleanup function on unmount/dep-change -> 'destroy is not a function' thrown during the commit phase, unmounting the whole admin tree. Fixed by wrapping the loader.
